description: Master source list. Classification: OFFICIAL = league/team official properties; TRUSTED = established aggregators citing official reports; MARKET = sportsbook feeds (no official league source exists). Every data row in this repo links to one of these.

sources.name: NFL.com game pages
sources.used_for: per-game result/lineup verification (row-level links in week9/week10.json)

sources.name: ESPN NFL Injuries (aggregates official team reports)
ESPN team depth charts (RotoWire)
sources.used_for: depth.json (PIT, BAL) - NOT official team charts (F-05)

sources.name: ESPN report: Seahawks-Raiders Week 10 (Lock starts, Nwosu/Shaheed return)
This repo's own scripts (model output)
sources.used_for: lines_week10.json, correlation.json, luck.json - derived, labeled as model output

whitelist_note: Proposed whitelist (Q-12): nfl.com + official team sites = OFFICIAL; ESPN (citing team reports) = TRUSTED; DraftKings via ESPN = MARKET. Anything else needs owner approval before use.
